title: Partial Differential Equation Barriers to Identifiability in Infinite Mixture Models
summary: We study identifiability of mixing measures in infinite mixture models. We show that, in many common cases, lack of identifiability can be characterized in terms of certain differential structures of the kernel family with respect to its parameters. In our main results, we prove that when the kernel is annihilated by a non-trivial differential or difference-differential operator over the parameter space, there exist infinitely many distinct mixing measures yielding the same mixture density.
